repairs: Buyer and conversation views render the selected loaded project synchronously; they no longer issue redundant GET requests that can overwrite edits or append to a later route.
Discovery responses and errors apply only to the active route generation and latest discovery request.
All current replacements use one confirmation and generation/revision guard: manual creation, candidate admission, project open including same-project reopen, and server reload.

If edits change while a replacement request is pending, the existing draft remains open. Save locks view controls, blocks route changes, and invalidates pending replacements until its response is applied.
